scope: Exploratory comparison on tuning split only; not final evaluation or Orin
preprocessing: same project load_h5/preprocess as prior training/evaluation
depth_units: native mirror units; conversion chain not independently verified
metric_notes: positive finite target mask; pooled pixel metrics; equal-weight mean-image and mean-scene RMSE; nonpositive predictions handled by DepthMetrics
limitations: The tuning set has been inspected in previous comparisons, and original pretraining overlap remains unknown. Images within scenes are correlated. Random masks and training orders both vary by seed. No Orin or held-out final claim.
